description: This file defines the interface class IGstWebAudioPlayerClient, which is used for notification callbacks related to the web audio player's state in the Rialto gstreamer media framework. It includes licensing information, include guards, and a single pure virtual method notifyState to inform the client of state changes.

classes.name: IGstWebAudioPlayerClient
classes.description: An abstract base class defining the interface for clients to receive notifications about the web audio player's state changes.

methods.name: notifyState
methods.description: Pure virtual method to notify the client of the current web audio player state.
